# Fictional career account: Ivo Moss

Collections Coordinator at Willow Museum, 2019 to 2025.

Changed from museum operations to digital collections. Employer start and end years are known; months are unknown and must not be invented. A grant funder is not my employer. A private client project must stay private.

## Maple archive

Moved the Maple archive service online in 2021. It became available all day. Usage growth and savings were never measured.

## Pine access project

Co-designed Pine access labels with volunteers, making the collection easier to navigate. Volunteers implemented the physical labels. My individual contribution was the design and coordination.

## Elm invention

Named co-inventor on the Elm preservation method. The application has not been filed. No patent number exists. Defer questions until a filing occurs.

## Education and training

Digital Cataloguing course completed 2022, training without certification.
